### {{< fa laptop >}} Computing

We use **Python** in **Google Colab**, so there is nothing to install. You need a
browser and your WFU Google account.

Start here: [Getting Started with Colab](colab.qmd).

The [Python Quick Guide](python-guide.qmd) has the R to Python translation.

### {{< fa question-circle >}} Stuck?

Read [Troubleshooting](troubleshooting.qmd) first, then see [Help](help.qmd) for
office hours and information about the Math & Stats Center.

### {{< fa laptop-code >}} Materials

This class is hands on. Bring a charged laptop to every class.
